::: {#def-rnffrcitg .theorem}
## RNFFRCISTG

A random network finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (RNFFRCISTG) is a causal model defined relative to an [NPSEM-GE](#def-npsem-ge) which satisfies the (1) [no spillover](#def-no-spillover), (2) [homogenous random network interference](#def-homogenous-random-network-interference) with respect to [graph generators](#def-graph-generator) $\mathcal H$, and (3) [identical distributions](#def-identical-distributions) assumptions.
:::
